# susieR0.16.6 deterministic feature fixtures

Source: susieR0.16.6 commit8e56a8e038e989856d106d9ca5175cc664fea9d2, bundled N2finemapping and N3finemapping datasets.
The upstream authors and BSD-3-Clause terms are retained in LICENSE.BSD-3-Clause.
These are regression fixtures from bundled data, not a new simulation study.
reference.json records exact deterministic row/column subsets, raw inputs, fitted alpha in original row order, auxiliary outputs and every R failure.
Regenerate only into a new directory; existing reference bytes are never silently replaced.
